title: Pulse
tagline: Four lanes, three tracks, no forgiveness.
description: A rhythm game with its own music. Three tracks were written for it — an arpeggio-driven chase, a slower one in the rain, and something faster than either — and the charts were cut from the same notes you hear, so what falls down the lane is exactly what is playing. Hit early or late and it will tell you which. Your best score and accuracy are kept for each track.
author: HexCave
controls: D F J K, or the arrow keys
howToPlay: Four lanes, three original tracks written for this game.
Hit each note as it crosses the line with D, F, J and K.
Score and accuracy are kept separately for every track.
goal: Hit every note. Score and accuracy are kept separately for each of the three tracks.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.

1.1.1.notes: Hints keep clear of each game’s own controls.
